operations.title: Finite-symmetry averaging produces a natural repair only after inverting its order
operations.statement: For finite Gamma of order m acting on a nonempty radical-repair torsor, if m is invertible the affine orbit average is a Gamma-fixed repair. Fixed repairs remain a torsor under A^Gamma.

operations.title: Integral affine C2 action defeats repair averaging
operations.procedure: Let C2 act on the integral repair torsor by x->1-x.
operations.outcome: The only formal fixed point is 1/2, so no integral averaged repair exists; it appears after inverting two.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies unconditional natural-repair existence from finite symmetry and repair existence.
